title: 第一封信

series.next: Season one is over. A new note under the door, in 小钟's handwriting.

setting: The club room, 3:20 am. The light is on. Someone is sitting in 阿乐's chair, stroking a cat.

ke.name: 柯老师
ke.en: in 阿乐's chair, with a cat

steps.narr: You burst in together, four torches up, 果果's camera rolling.

else.narr: 老鲁 opens the club door with his own key, and stands aside to let you in.

steps.narr: In 阿乐's chair: a woman in a white coat, stroking a big grey cat. It looks just like 包子, only older.
Behind you, the door clicks shut. Locked.

steps.en: 包子? What are you doing here?

say.en: Ask the woman, politely: who are you?
say.tip: 您 nín = you, the polite one: for someone older than you.

ok.en: My name's 柯. Sit down. There's nothing to be scared of.

ok.zh: 这不是你们的包子。这是四号，它妈妈。
ok.en: That isn't your 包子. This is the Fourth: its mother.

4.gloss: At this hour... excuse me, who are you?

steps.narr: On the table: the twenty-year-old photos from the parcel, laid out in a row. A cat in every one.

steps.zh: 这是包子一号，这是二号，这是三号。
steps.en: That's 包子 the First. That's the Second. That's the Third.
Yours is 包子 the Fifth.

steps.narr: In the oldest photo, behind the students, a sign over a door. The same words are on the badge on her coat.

steps.zh: 宠物门诊……您是校医院的兽医？
steps.en: The pet clinic... you're the campus vet?

say.en: Say it: she wrote the letters.

not.note: 老鲁 has the keys. Who knows the name of every cat in those photos?

say.tip: 是……的 says who did it: 信是您写的 = it was you who wrote the letters.

ok.en: Yes. The first one was mine.

miss.narr: Everyone looks where you're pointing: at the cat. A fourth time.
包子's mother yawns, very slowly, right at you.

miss.en: ...It was 柯老师 who wrote them, surely?

answers: 那些信，都是柯老师您写的！
4.gloss: Those letters: you wrote every one, 柯老师!

say.en: Ask her, gently: why did she do it?
say.tip: 为什么 wèishénme = why. 这么做 = do it like this.

ok.zh: 二十年前，我是第一任社长。
ok.en: Twenty years ago, I was the club's first president.

ok.zh: 我们抓的鬼，都是假的。可是来找我们的人，都是真的。
ok.en: Every ghost we caught was fake. But everyone who came to us was real.

ok.zh: 这样的社团，只有有人需要它，才活得下去。
ok.en: A club like this only stays alive while someone needs it.

ok.zh: 所以我替你们找：小潘，邓阿姨，小钟。
ok.en: So I found them for you: 小潘, 邓阿姨, 小钟.

fail.en: What do you want to ask?

answers: 柯老师，您为什么要这么做呢？
4.gloss: 柯老师, why would you do all this?

steps.zh: 每一个包子，都是上一个的孩子。我负责打疫苗。
steps.en: Every 包子 is the last one's kitten. I do the jabs.
And now you don't need me any more.

say.en: Ask her to come back to the club, or tell her: from now on, you'll find the cases yourselves.
say.gloss: 柯老师, come back to us!
say.tip: ……吧 makes it a warm ask: 您回来吧 = do come back.

ok.zh: 那您就是第一个四十五岁的社员！
ok.en: Then you'll be our first forty-five-year-old member!

alts.en: Or: from now on, you'll find them yourselves
alts.gloss: From now on, we'll find them ourselves.

then.narr: 柯老师 hands 阿乐 a key on a red string: the club room's spare.

answers: 柯老师，假鬼社需要您，回来吧！
4.gloss: 柯老师, 假鬼社 needs you. Come back!

answers: 您放心，以后我们自己找。
alts.gloss: Don't worry. From now on, we'll find them ourselves.

steps.narr: Behind you, the door swings open by itself. It was never locked, only stuck.

steps.en: Dawn. Five members, two 包子s, and a new name on the club list in very neat handwriting. Season one ends here. 🐈

else.en: Dawn. Four members, one 包子, one spare key on a red string, and no idea who comes next. Season one ends here. 🐈
